title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
oneLinerQuestion: Find all grid cells where water can flow to both Pacific and Atlantic oceans.
explanation: Run DFS backward from Ocean boundaries inward (Pacific top/left edges, Atlantic bottom/right edges) uphill (neighbor >= current). Final answer is the intersection of both reachable coordinate sets.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION pacificAtlantic(heights):
    ROWS = LENGTH(heights), COLS = LENGTH(heights[0]), pac = SET(), atl = SET()
    FUNCTION dfs(r, c, visit, prevHeight):
        IF (r,c) IN visit OR r < 0 OR c < 0 OR r >= ROWS OR c >= COLS OR heights[r][c] < prevHeight THEN RETURN
        ADD (r,c) TO visit
        dfs(r+1, c, visit, heights[r][c]); dfs(r-1, c, visit, heights[r][c])
        dfs(r, c+1, visit, heights[r][c]); dfs(r, c-1, visit, heights[r][c])
    END FUNCTION
    FOR c FROM 0 TO COLS-1 DO dfs(0, c, pac, heights[0][c]); dfs(ROWS-1, c, atl, heights[ROWS-1][c])
    FOR r FROM 0 TO ROWS-1 DO dfs(r, 0, pac, heights[r][0]); dfs(r, COLS-1, atl, heights[r][COLS-1])
    RETURN INTERSECTION(pac, atl)
END FUNCTION
